blacklistabilityReview.evidence: mAPOLLO has a single Ethereum deployment: proxy 0x7cf9dec92ca9fd46f8d86e7798b72624bc116c05, totalSupply 7,042,113.97 (18dp) at block 26224764 (2026-10-19), so the deployment is material by construction. The proxy resolves to verified implementation 0xd43cc40e380a59bfc06e80fdea9847556297df0c; mAPOLLO inherits mTBILL/mToken, whose _beforeTokenTransfer applies _onlyNotBlacklisted to sender and recipient, alongside role-gated pause (M_APOLLO_PAUSE_OPERATOR_ROLE) and privileged burn (M_APOLLO_BURN_OPERATOR_ROLE). The token reads shared MidasAccessControl 0x0312A9D1Ff2372DDEdCBB21e4B6389aFc919aC4B, where BLACKLIST_OPERATOR_ROLE had 60+ current holders at that block (hasRole true for 0x081bb8ad7f452f916991c17fdfa64d4a25153169), so an issuer operator can add any holder to BLACKLISTED_ROLE and stop its transfers.

oracleRisk.summary: Midas Software GmbH is mAPOLLO's calculation agent and can postpone NAV determination or apply fallback valuation methodologies during market disruption under the signed Final Terms. NAV is published through Ethereum oracle 0x84303e5568c7b167fa4febc6253cddfe12b7ee4b. This price-setting authority is distinct from automatic balance-derived vault accounting.

branchApplicability.rationale: Midas identifies mAPOLLO as a NAV-based liquid-yield investment product with issuer minting and redemption rails and a NAV oracle. The NAV is a price-sensitive top-level valuation and conversion authority; no borrower-owned debt, collateral threshold, liquidation auction, or token-level liquidation backstop exists for mAPOLLO.

sources.label: Signed mAPOLLO Final Terms dated 17 July 2026: calculation agent, NAV oracle and fallback valuation authority
